name: Yet Another Browser
tagline: Bring your Arc spaces and pinned tabs to a WebKit browser with optional AI agents.
description:
Yet Another Browser, also called Yab, is a free Mac browser built on WebKit. It offers an Arc-like workspace with sidebar tabs, folders, Spaces, Peek link previews, and Split View.

## Features

- Import Arc Spaces, pinned tabs, folders, passwords, and history.
- Open links in Peek and place two pages side by side.
- Switch between sidebar and horizontal tabs and find pages through the Command-T field.
- Block ads and trackers with built-in filter lists.
- Install supported Chrome Web Store extensions through WebKit's extension engine; compatibility varies by extension.
- Connect your own Claude or ChatGPT plan for optional agents that read and act in tabs. Sending, payments, and deletion require approval.

## Where it fits

Yab suits people who want Arc-style organization on Apple's browser engine, with optional automation. It uses WebKit rather than Chromium, so check your essential websites and extensions before switching.

## Privacy and requirements

Runs on Intel and Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15.4 or later; no Yab account is required. The developer says browsing data stays on the Mac, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync. Usage statistics can be disabled, and crash reports require consent. Content an agent reads is sent to its model provider when working on your task.

## Pricing

The browser is free. Optional AI uses your own third-party plan and its limits; Yab does not sell a separate AI subscription.

## Sources

[Official website](https://yetanotherbrowser.com/), [installation requirements](https://yetanotherbrowser.com/manual/getting-started), [extension support](https://yetanotherbrowser.com/manual/extensions), and [privacy](https://yetanotherbrowser.com/manual/privacy).
